scope: V2 visual prototype and frozen-v1 preservation; not a new RL benchmark result or physical validation

browser.default_camera: Orthographic, north up, 60 degrees above horizontal
browser.north_indicator: Grid north, camera-aware rotation; not true north
browser.scale: 500 metres at comparison framing; computed from orthographic horizontal projected metres
browser.performance_limit: First GPU draw took seconds to warm up; no broad GPU/frame-rate or40-cell stress claim. Test uses a single development replay, not a held-out benchmark.

review: Two delegated design workers; parent integration/browser assessment and independent code/visual feedback. Remaining mismatches are recorded in design_assessment.json.
